'''Myrnad''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Myrnad managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of [[biochemist]]ry to others.<ref name="TOR" />
